description_expanded:
Nancy's Folly | Camp District, WaterColor, FL

164 Pond Cypress Way, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459

As soon as you walk in to Nancy's Folly you get a wonderful sense of beach elegance. The owner has taken great care in decorating and furnishing all rooms in a nautical theme with gorgeous wearable fabrics that evoke a sense of luxury at the beach.

The front porch is an additional outdoor living room ideal for post-beach lounging or early evening gatherings before dinner. Upon entering the home you see lush drapery with furnishings that are nautical in colors and style. It is an open concept entryway, living area, dining area and newly remodeled kitchen which lend to wonderful family and friend gatherings for the entire group. Plenty of seating for conversing or watch TV on the large flat screen. There is seating for 8-10 people between the beautiful dining table and counter seating at the kitchen. There is also a screened-in porch with a dining table with seating for 6. Top of the line stainless steel appliances and high end surfaces make the kitchen warm and inviting to cook in. Just beyond the kitchen is a laundry room, a half bathroom and a king bedroom with access out onto the back porch and an ensuite bathroom with dual vanities, a shower and bathtub. The porch on the back has seating and a small table along with a gas grill and outdoor shower.

The second floor seating area is ideal for children to gather and watch TV or read a book on the couches (1 queen pullout). There are 3 bedrooms off of the living space. A queen bedroom with adjoining bathroom also connect to the hallway, convenient for anyone sleeping on the pullout couch. There is another queen bedroom with ensuite bathroom and the master king suite is located at the front of the house. It is extremely spacious with lovely furnishings including 2 cozy window seats and a beautifully appointed ensuite bathroom with large soaker tub and walk-in shower.

- Guest bedroom with king sized mattress and private bathroom offering a soaking tub, walk-in shower, and dual vanity sinks

- Screened-in porch with outdoor dining table

Second Floor

- Master bedroom with private bathroom featuring a soaking tub, walk-in shower, and dual vanity sinks

- 4 beach cruiser bicycles

Additional

- Guests can enjoy complimentary rides anywhere in WaterColor using the on-demand WaterColor Trolley, available through the WaterColor Trolley app in your app store.

- Parking for 2 Vehicles .

- No events, such as wedding receptions and other large gatherings are allowed. Only people sleeping in the home are allowed on this property. If violated, double cleaning fees, as well as other possible fees, will apply.

- No pet home. Per the signed Rental Agreement, any violation of the no pet policy will result in immediate eviction, plus additional cleaning charges.

- WaterColor HOA allows one golf cart per address- you may not rent a second cart if the home you have rented offers one. All golf cart rentals in Watercolor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to a specific amount throughout the community at any given time. Cart rentals are granted on a first-come, first-served based. Watercolor condos cannot rent golf carts.

- 10 Amenity Wristbands - Maximum. Extras are not available. Access to All WaterColor Community Swimming Pools - Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club.

- The HOA issues one parking pass per reservation. Guests are encouraged to park their vehicles in the driveway or garage of their rental home. They do not need a parking pass when their vehicle is parked on a private residential property.The HOA-issued parking pass is required to park a vehicle overnight on the common area parking pads.

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum Age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking.

- Except for a $250 Cancellation Fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancellations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM.

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
